checks: ClaimVersion fixes exact claim text, type, question version, subject/metric/period/unit/denominator/comparison scope and conditions
EvidenceRecord binds one exact SourceIntake, its structure version, node locator/hash set and W21 event cluster membership including exact source URL
ClaimEvidenceAssessment separately records SUPPORTS, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, BACKGROUND_ONLY, IRRELEVANT or UNRESOLVED with supported scope, unsupported aspects, counterevidence and unknowns
locator replay verifies exact source bytes/node hashes but never claims automatic semantic truth or causal support
lineage roots come from the exact source member in the declared W21 event cluster, not from URL or publication counts
distinct roots are counted and evidence duplicating an already-seen root increments same_root_duplicate_count rather than independent_root_count
evidence with no recorded root is retained as independence-unknown and does not inflate independence

SUM, DIFFERENCE, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE and PERCENT_CHANGE execute through a local Decimal evaluator and retain exact source-node/value/unit/dimension/period inputs, formula, rounding, declared expectation, result and result hash
numeric text and unit literals must occur in the exact source node; input data periods must equal SourceIntake data periods
wrong period/value/unit, mismatched dimensions, zero denominators, incorrect expected result and unrepresentable precision fail
arbitrary generated code is not accepted or executed; only the declared deterministic evaluator runs and records EXECUTED
SupplementRequest binds a specific gap, distinguishing evidence, owner and continuation trigger to an optional claim and prior assessment
SupplementResult distinguishes EVIDENCE_ADDED, PARTIAL, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and NO_NEW_EVIDENCE and records before/after relation plus impact
EVIDENCE_ADDED requires actual SourceIntake, Evidence and new ClaimEvidenceAssessment versions; every evidence source and every assessment evidence citation must match the result
object/scope change requires S8 review; GPT Researcher trial remains explicitly unavailable and cannot be recorded as if executed
EvidenceRecord uses the shared ObjectKind.EVIDENCE and can be consumed by W16 ResearchRevision evidence_version_ids
W25 records reference exact W24 source intakes/structures and W21 lineage proposals in the shared Archive
all outputs state facts_verified=false and causal_support=false; none authorizes publication
